sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt - Instant Payment Network (IPN)
Central Bank of Egypt - Mobile Wallets (last updated 23 Mar 2023)
CBE - Rules Regulating Payment Services Using Mobile Phones, 3rd edition (April 2021, Arabic)

notes: Fawry publishes no numeric transaction or balance limits on its own pages, so limits.json carries no Fawry entry. The October 2021 IPN rules set EGP 50,000 per transaction, EGP 60,000 daily and EGP 200,000 monthly; those figures have since been raised and are not carried as current facts here.

entries.subject: instapay_max_per_transaction
entries.quote: The maximum transaction value 70,000 (seventy thousand) Egyptian pounds.
entries.notes: CBE page last updated 2 Feb 2025. InstaPay's own site and AfricaNenda SIIPS 2025 give the same figure.

entries.subject: instapay_max_daily
entries.display: EGP 120,000 maximum per day, per bank
entries.quote: The maximum daily transaction value 120,000 (one hundred and twenty thousand) Egyptian pounds.
entries.notes: Daily cap is per bank registered in the app, not per customer.

entries.subject: instapay_max_monthly
entries.display: EGP 400,000 maximum per month, per bank
entries.quote: The maximum monthly transaction value 400,000 (four hundred thousand) Egyptian pounds.
entries.notes: Confirmed by InstaPay's site (EGP 400,000 monthly per bank).

entries.subject: instapay_limit_scope
entries.value_text: per bank registered in the InstaPay app
entries.quote: These limits are per bank registered in the app
entries.notes: Three banks registered means three times the headline daily and monthly caps.

entries.subject: mobile_wallet_individual_daily_limit
entries.display: EGP 30,000 per day for individual e-wallets
entries.quote: The maximum limit for transactions using an e-wallet for individuals is 30,000 EGP/day and 100,000 EGP/month.
entries.notes: Same figure in the April 2021 mobile-wallet rules (3-6-6-3-1) and in EnterpriseAM's report of the April 2021 circular. The page itself was last updated 23 Mar 2023.

entries.subject: mobile_wallet_individual_monthly_limit
entries.display: EGP 100,000 per month for individual e-wallets
entries.quote: The maximum limit for transactions using an e-wallet for individuals is 30,000 EGP/day and 100,000 EGP/month.
entries.notes: Mirrors the 2021 rules and EnterpriseAM's summary of the same circular.

entries.subject: max_wallets_per_national_id
entries.display: At most 3 e-wallets per national ID
entries.quote: A maximum of 3 e-wallets per National ID.
entries.notes: One wallet per mobile number; three wallets per person.

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_daily_limit
entries.display: EGP 60,000 of wallet transactions per day
entries.notes: Vodafone's own figure, double the EGP 30,000/day the CBE Mobile Wallets page still states for individuals; the CBE page predates later amendments not captured in this corpus. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_monthly_limit
entries.display: EGP 200,000 of wallet transactions per month
entries.notes: Double the EGP 100,000/month on the CBE Mobile Wallets page. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_max_balance
entries.quote: The maximum amount of money you can keep in your wallet is 100,000 EGP.
entries.notes: A balance ceiling, distinct from the transaction ceilings. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: mobile_wallet_legal_person_a_daily_limit
entries.display: EGP 40,000 per day for legal persons, category A
entries.quote: (أربعـون ألـف) 40,000 الفئـة (أ) مـن الأشـخاص الاعتبارييـن: مبلـغ جنيهـاً مصريـاً.
entries.notes: Arabic source (3rd edition, April 2021), clause 3-6-6-3-1. Category B legal persons get the same limit as natural persons.

entries.subject: mobile_wallet_legal_person_a_monthly_limit
entries.display: EGP 200,000 per month for legal persons, category A
entries.quote: (مائتـان ألـف) 200,000 الفئـة (أ) مـن الأشـخاص الاعتبارييـن: مبلـغ جنيهـا مصريـاً.
entries.notes: Arabic source, clause 3-6-6-3-2. EnterpriseAM's April 2021 report of the same circular gives EGP 40k/day and EGP 200k/month for licensed microenterprises.
